answer: A forged receipt fails at the first cross-check, because the issuer keeps a copy of its own. I would wager my own seat on Line engraver gem stone proof engraved into the die workshop, because its proof, each gem stone is a plate record witnessed by the inspector, is public and checkable. One mask pays 107 POA and waits 9 days; a farm pays 68801 POA and still waits 9 days per mask. Hand the panel a summit it can verify, a mirror it can count, and a harbor it can date, and the panel will do the rest. The farm's story ends the same way every epoch: a hundred keys printed, and no proof among them.
